description: Retrieve the full text + metadata for any `id` returned by `search`. Handles all three kinds: `ruling:<n>` (a court decision with its linked companies), `law:<n>` (an act in its current redaktsioon, all paragraphs) and `section:<n>:<par>` (a single paragraph, much shorter than a whole act). Returns Markdown plus the canonical lahend.ee URL.
name: fetch

text.description: The full decision rendered as Markdown.

title: Fetch a court decision by id
